test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Mumbai is the city of dreams but it is a expensive city too.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the article "**a**" before the term "**expensive city**."
 
• The correct article should be "**an**" as it precedes a word starting with a vowel sound.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an expensive city too**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mumbai is the city of dreams but it is** an **expensive city too."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Mumbai is the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "city of dreams"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "but it is"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
